title: The Gap on GAP: Tackling the Problem of Differing Data Distributions in Bias-Measuring Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on a statistical method to improve the measurement of gender bias in coreference resolution models. While bias is an ethical concern, the paper does not benchmark or evaluate models on their understanding or application of religion, morals, or broader ethical frameworks. The scope is technical and confined to correcting imbalances in a diagnostic dataset.
